about_the_game:
Moorhuhn 2 - The Hunt Goes On!

The legend returns, deeper and more strategic than ever! Moorhuhn 2 is the official sequel to the cult classic The Original Moorhuhn Hunt, expanding the frantic 90-second gameplay with tons of secrets, puzzles, and strategic layers. This isn't just a remake—it's the definitive hunting experience!

Strategy Trumps Mindless Blasting

Simply shooting at random won't get you to the top of the leaderboards. Moorhuhn 2 rewards a keen eye and an experimental spirit. The entire landscape is an interactive playground, packed with scoring opportunities that go way beyond the feathered targets. Your curiosity is your greatest weapon in the hunt for the high score.

Gameplay Depth & Features

  • Tons of Targets: Beyond the chickens, which vary in value, you can hit dozens of hidden objects—from flowers and frogs to towers and balloons. Each with its own score.

  • Interactive World: Trigger chain reactions! Pop the scarecrow to flood the screen with new targets, or hit the church tower for precious bonus seconds.

  • Hidden Power-Ups: Unlock powerful special ammo by shooting specific objects, or instantly refill your magazine by blasting all the stones in the landscape.

  • Know Your Targets: Not everything that moves is fair game. Hitting planes or zeppelins will deduct serious points. Aim carefully!

  • Timing is Everything: True pros know that hits in the final seconds of a round are worth way more points.

  • Global Steam Leaderboards: Pit your strategic skills against players worldwide and battle for the #1 spot. 🏆

  • Authentic Retro Experience: Enjoy the original graphics and unforgettable sound of the 2000 cult classic, perfectly playable with mouse & keyboard or controller.

Sharpen your aim, lock and load, and prove you're more than just a shooter — become a master strategist of the Moorhuhn hunt!
